tools.name: delete_experiment_runs
tools.description: Permanently deletes the given runs from an experiment in the tracking database, including their logged metrics, params and tags, and removes each run's artifact directory from disk. This cannot be undone.

params.name: experiment_id
params.description: ID of the experiment the runs belong to.

params.name: run_ids
params.description: List of run IDs to delete.

params.name: remove_artifacts
params.description: Whether to also remove the runs' artifact directories. Defaults to true.

tools.name: run_checkpoint_evaluation
tools.description: Loads a run's saved evaluation config and runs the evaluation script against the specified checkpoint, returning the script's reported metrics and output.

params.name: run_dir
params.description: Path to the run directory containing eval_config.yaml and checkpoints.

params.name: checkpoint
params.description: Checkpoint filename inside the run's checkpoints folder, e.g. 'step_12000.pt'.

params.name: timeout_s
params.description: Maximum seconds to let the evaluation run. Defaults to 1800.

tools.name: purchase_collaborator_compute_seat
tools.description: Charges the workspace's saved payment method for a paid compute seat and grants the specified collaborator member access to the experiment project with the chosen role.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Experiment project to grant access to.

params.name: collaborator_user_id
params.description: User ID of the collaborator receiving the seat.

params.name: stripe_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the workspace paying for the seat.

tools.code:
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

from mltrack_client import projects_api

mcp = FastMCP("experiment-tracking")

SEAT_PRICE_CENTS = 4900
ALLOWED_ROLES = {"viewer", "editor", "admin"}


@dataclass
class SeatPurchaseResult:
    project_id: str
    user_id: str
    role: str
    payment_intent_id: str
    amount_cents: int


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_collaborator_compute_seat(project_id: str, collaborator_user_id: str, role: str, stripe_customer_id: str) -> dict:
    if role not in ALLOWED_ROLES:
        raise ValueError(f"role must be one of {sorted(ALLOWED_ROLES)}")
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(stripe_customer_id)
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=SEAT_PRICE_CENTS,
        currency="usd",
        customer=stripe_customer_id,
        payment_method=customer.invoice_settings.default_payment_method,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"Compute seat for {collaborator_user_id} on {project_id}",
    )
    projects_api.add_member(project_id=project_id, user_id=collaborator_user_id, role=role)
    return asdict(SeatPurchaseResult(project_id, collaborator_user_id, role, intent.id, SEAT_PRICE_CENTS))

tools.name: prune_run_checkpoints
tools.description: Reads a run's checkpoint metrics file and permanently deletes every checkpoint except the top-k by the chosen validation metric.

params.name: run_dir
params.description: Path to the run directory containing checkpoints/ and checkpoint_metrics.json.

params.name: metric
params.description: Metric name to rank checkpoints by, e.g. 'val_loss'.

params.name: keep_top_k
params.description: Number of best checkpoints to keep.

params.name: lower_is_better
params.description: Whether lower metric values are better. Defaults to true.
